introductions.title: Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two
The Dimension of the Two-Adic Hecke Algebra at Odd Level

results.name: unrestricted_pro_modularity
results.statement: For any continuous odd absolutely irreducible two-dimensional 2-adic Galois representation unramified outside finitely many primes, existence of an odd tame level N and continuous homomorphism from the full varying-weight 2-adic Hecke algebra matching Frobenius traces and determinants.
results.boundary: Pro-modular occurrence, not classical cuspidal modularity without regular de Rham hypotheses.

results.name: hecke_dimension
results.statement: Every irreducible component of full 2-adic Hecke algebra for every odd positive tame level N has Krull dimension exactly four.
results.boundary: Dimension statement, not modularity of individual Galois representations.

results.name: fontaine_mazur
results.statement: Continuous irreducible odd two-dimensional 2-adic representations, finitely ramified and regular de Rham at 2, are Tate twists of classical cuspidal eigenform Galois representations.
results.boundary: Requires regular de Rham and distinct Hodge–Tate weights; stronger classicality is not implied by pro-modular occurrence alone.
